identity_cost.detail: email: an account needs an email address and authentication ('An email address and authentication information are necessary for an account; payment and usage information are necessary for a paid plan.'). A card is not required for the 7-day trial: the same statement makes payment information necessary for a paid plan, and the trial page states 'Start a 7-day free trial on Basic. No browser to install, no servers to run.'. A phone is not required: the policy's account data is 'your email address, password authentication records, language preferences, account identifiers, API credentials and security events', which names no phone. Country: not published at https://cloudbrowser.ai/privacy-policy.
